title: How much does apartment interior design cost in Kyiv in 2026: price per m²
seo_title: Interior Design Cost in Kyiv 2026: Price per m²
description: How much apartment design costs in Kyiv: from $30/m², minimum $2,500. What the price includes, sample calculations and how to save without losing quality.
lead: The cost of an interior design project is the first question owners ask before a renovation. Here is how the price is built in Kyiv, why it is calculated per square metre, what you get for the money and how not to overpay for either the design or the renovation.

body: How much interior design for an apartment costs in Kyiv

Interior design is usually priced per square metre of floor area. At CAS Development a full design project costs from $30 per m², with a minimum project fee of $2,500. For smaller apartments the minimum applies: the work on the kitchen, bathroom and layout hardly depends on whether you have 45 m² or 70 m².

A per-metre price is convenient because you immediately see the order of magnitude. But comparing offers on that figure alone is a mistake — what matters is what the project includes, how many drawings it contains and whether a renovation can be priced from it straight away.
50 m² apartment: 50 × $30 = $1,500, so the minimum fee of $2,500 applies

This is a benchmark at the base rate. We confirm the exact fee after seeing the apartment and taking the brief: a complex layout, several bathrooms or a lot of bespoke furniture increase the scope of work. The rate is the same whether we work in person in Kyiv or fully online for a property elsewhere.
What a full interior design project includes
working drawings for the crew: demolition, new walls, electrics, plumbing, ceilings, floors
specification of materials, furniture and lighting

If a project is cheaper than the market, it most often lacks working drawings or specifications. The crew then works from a picture and decisions are made on site — the main source of overspending and rework.
Living room with a cream sofa, oval side tables and a statement painting — Edelweiss design project
Single-wall kitchen with a dining area in warm tones — Edelweiss design project
apartment floor area and number of bathrooms
layout complexity: moving walls and wet areas, combining the kitchen and living room
amount of bespoke furniture that needs separate drawings
whether design supervision is needed during the renovation

The price is driven less by square metres than by the number of decisions that need to be thought through and drawn. A kitchen with an island, several bathrooms, walk-in wardrobes and bespoke furniture each need their own drawings, so the cost grows with complexity, not just with area.
Classic-style living room with mouldings, an upholstered sofa and wall lights — Hodos villa design project
What the renovation itself will cost

The design is usually a small share of the total budget; the main costs are renovation, materials and furniture. Apartment renovation with CAS starts from $550 per m²: from $38,500 for a 70 m² apartment, from $55,000 for 100 m². Against that, a design fee of $2,500–3,000 pays for itself, because an accurate estimate and specifications keep the budget from creeping.

If our own team carries out the renovation to our design, we guarantee the final cost will not deviate from the estimate by more than ±5%. [Turnkey furnishing](/en/turnkey-furnishing) is priced separately — from $250 per m².
Common mistakes when commissioning a design
choosing an [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) on the lowest price per m² alone, without comparing what the project includes
ordering only 3D without working drawings — the crew will still ask where the sockets and outlets go
starting the renovation before the layout and electrics are approved
not budgeting for furniture and lighting — they often cost more than expected
skipping design supervision where the project is complex
How to save without losing quality
do not change decisions after the layout is approved — every change means reworking drawings and the estimate
choose materials from the specification, not by eye in a shop
furniture, lighting and decor can be sourced directly from China — noticeably cheaper than retail prices
order the design and [design implementation](/en/design-implementation) from one team: fewer losses at the interface between designer and crew
you know the exact floor area and have a plan from the developer or the property register
you have decided who will live there and which zones you need: study, walk-in wardrobe, nursery
you have collected examples of interiors you like and ones you do not
you know your indicative budget for renovation and furniture, not just for the design
the studio has given you a list of the documents the project will include

faq: How much does interior design for a 60 m² apartment cost?
At $30 per m² it comes to $1,800, so the minimum project fee of $2,500 applies. It covers apartments up to roughly 83 m². We confirm the exact fee after reviewing the apartment.
Can I order just the layout?
Yes, individual stages can be discussed. But the biggest savings on the renovation come from a full project with drawings and specifications.
Is design supervision included in the design fee?
Design supervision is a separate service. Its cost is agreed together with the project, depending on the complexity of the renovation.
Does a design project pay for itself?
In most cases, yes: drawings and an estimate reduce rework and unnecessary purchases, and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final cost stays within ±5% of the estimate.
